task.description:
WF-03 Step 1: Root Cause Diagnosis

Issue: ISS-0601-LEAK-001 - Memory leak in src/definition/store.zig parseGraphJson

Perform deep diagnosis per docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md:
1. Read the affected source file: src/definition/store.zig parseGraphJson function
2. Trace the allocation sites: all allocator.dupe() calls for node.id, node.label, node.kind, edge.from, edge.to, edge.label
3. Trace the deallocation path: where/how are these freed? (spoiler: they are not)
4. Identify ownership: who owns these duped strings? Definition struct? Caller?
5. Check if Definition has a deinit method
6. Search for prior solutions in docs/issues/issue_index.json (fn:search-issues)
7. Propose fix strategy: add Definition.deinit(), use arena allocator, or transfer ownership
8. Write diagnosis to docs/issue-reports/ISS-0601-LEAK-001-diagnosis.yaml

Output in artifacts_out: docs/issue-reports/ISS-0601-LEAK-001-diagnosis.yaml

Return PASS with clear fix strategy recommendation.
acceptance_criteria: Diagnosis identifies all allocation sites in parseGraphJson
Fix strategy considers impact on all Definition load sites

result.summary: Root cause diagnosis complete: parseGraphJson allocates 8+ strings per Definition graph that are never freed. Cleanup function freeDefinitionGraph exists but is not consistently called. Recommended fix: add Definition.deinit() method and update all 100+ call sites.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV for Step 2 (fix implementation) or ORCH for rework routing decision
